name: resistance band standing single arm lateral shoulder extension
description: A one-arm band move that pulls the arm out and back to the side. It works the shoulder and the muscles behind it.
instructions: Anchor the band at about waist height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, arm across your body.
Keep your chest tall and core braced.
Sweep the arm out and slightly back to the side with a soft elbow.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap.
Complete all reps, then turn around and switch arms.
